rows.surface: Recovered-to-source transition preserves container records, identity and account recovery
rows.mechanism: Offline read-only inventory verifies the private runtime archive against its saved manifest, compares global and per-app metadata by stable ID, counts records rather than directories, and flags unsupported memberships, unreviewed fields, conflicting namespaces and pre-existing source state. It neither converts data nor authorizes an installation.

evidence.detail: Bounded no-extraction archive verification and aggregate metadata report. Names, credentials and identity values are not emitted. Installation/account/Keychain/identity-conversion flags remain false.

Python behavior tests cover 107 records, reordered per-app indexes, mismatches, foreign app membership, malformed/unsafe/oversized/truncated inputs, metadata links, manifest integrity, multiple namespaces, original-byte retention and secret-free reporting.
Source candidate migration and installation acceptance requirements remain separate from a component license test or package build.

rows.verification: 17 host test methods pass; static checks pass. Saved .17 manager-state backup verifies 17,472 archive entries and 107 global records plus 107 matching index records, all with unsupported app membership. This is a saved archive, not a fresh phone snapshot or evidence of 107 logged-in accounts. Phone is not visible on USB during this turn.
rows.fix: Capture fresh quiescent state, reconcile existing source data, map supported app/account/identity data without regeneration, establish Keychain recovery, implement a journaled transition and verify device migration plus rollback before removing the mixed-engine installation guard.
